title: Sina MO batch replay strips an invalid identifier prefix and bypasses exact variable identity validation
entry_path: ic_im_evidence_adapter_v1.capture_daily (MO source Eastmoney) -> _prefetch_mo_replay_verification -> CaptureSession -> EvidenceReader.http_response (batch projection) -> verify_sina_option_quote
trigger: Recorded Sina batch variables use xhq_str_P_OP_mo... or not_hq_str_P_OP_mo... instead of exact hq_str_P_OP_mo...; request contains at least two symbols so single-symbol recovery takes the projection branch.
expected: Malformed identity rejected before seal and/or by replay; direct and recovered quote validation must agree.
actual: Both prefixes pass prefetch. Generic capture is marked complete, validates hashes and loads. Projection removes the invalid prefix and verify_sina_option_quote accepts the price. The same malformed single packet is rejected by the direct consumer.

mutations: add x or not_ before hq_str_
duplicate first quote with symbol changed to MO2611-P-6100 only, to exercise batch projection; no claim second contract market values are real

scope_limit: No live provider corruption was observed; no full builder/StateStore/ledger acceptance asserted. This proves identity loss in the real capture/seal/load/projection/consumer chain under explicitly mutated raw input.
patch: Use one shared exact-identifier parser for direct consumption, prefetch and replay projection; require a negative lookbehind/lexical boundary before hq_str_, validate unique exact expected IDs, and project only the validated full variable span. Do not reconstruct a legitimate identifier from an arbitrary substring. Reject old malformed archives on read.
acceptance: Existing 3 positive/direct rejection controls stay passing
4 rejection regression cases pass after correction
Add duplicate/overlapping batch and prefix cases covering both capture and read paths
Re-run the 43-file daily gate and full cumulative bound suite, then real original-day IC/IM replay parity
